name: IR-9X Replicator Droid
description: The IR-9X Replicator Droid was a model of humanoid battle droid used by the Shroud, a freelance spy active during the Galactic War. IR-9X Replicators were capable of generating sophisticated holograms over their frames, allowing for highly-effective disguises, and a number of them were stored at the Shroud's factory on the moon Nar Shaddaa.
